$comment: The WIZARD interview. One source for the terminal interview (wizard.py interview), for agents (wizard.py questions) and for the docs. Plain words only: the reader may never have used an AI agent.

helpers.name: the Builder
helpers.does: writes and fixes code, websites and automations
helpers.first_job: Builder: make a simple one-page website for {project}.

helpers.name: the Researcher
helpers.does: looks things up, compares options and writes you a plan
helpers.first_job: Researcher: find five problems {audience} have that {project} could solve, with sources.

helpers.name: the Time-Keeper
helpers.does: tracks how much of your time the team uses, and the one fix that saves you the most
helpers.first_job: Time-Keeper: run the owner-auditor for this week.

helpers.name: the Listener
helpers.does: reads what people say about your work (comments, reviews, threads) and tells you what they want. It never replies or posts
helpers.first_job: Listener: read what {audience} say about work like {project} and tell me what they ask for most.

helpers.name: the Writer
helpers.does: turns one piece you approved into drafts for other places, in your voice. It never posts anything
helpers.first_job: Writer: turn this approved piece into three short drafts in my voice.

questions.ask: What should your team call you?
What is the name of your brand, business or art project?

choices.label: A personal brand or content creator

questions.ask: In one or two sentences, what do you make or do?
questions.example: We bake sourdough bread and sell it at two weekend markets.
Busy families near the market who want real bread.

questions.ask: What are the top one to three things you want help with right now? Separate them with commas.
questions.example: an online order page, more people at the Saturday market, a weekly newsletter

questions.ask: When your team writes for you, how should it sound? Give about three words.
Is there anything your team must never do or say? Separate with commas, or leave it empty.
questions.example: never promise delivery dates, never mention prices without asking me

questions.default: Anything that gets published, sent to someone, or costs money.
questions.ask: What must always get your OK first?
questions.example: Anything that gets published, sent to someone, or costs money.

questions.ask: Which helpers do you want on your team? You can change this later.
Which AI app will you use your team in?

choices.label: A chat app that can't open folders (like a chat website)
Another one, or I'm not sure yet

questions.ask: Do you also want a long-term memory for your team (a 'second brain': a private notebook of everything it learns)?

choices.label: Yes, show me how to add it

focus_question: What is the first job you would hand to {name}? (It {does}.)
